subject: E-Commerce
title: Pets.com and the Sock Puppet
description: One-minute skill: Pets.com and the Sock Puppet.

hook.text: Pets.com spent $12 for every $1 it earned selling pet food. Its sock puppet mascot became a cultural icon.

buildup.text: Free shipping on heavy bags of dog food guaranteed losses. Each order cost more to fulfill than it earned.

discovery.text: Pets.com spent millions on a Super Bowl ad before proving its model worked. Marketing outpaced math.

twist.text: Amazon invested in Pets.com, watched it fail, then launched its own pet section using those lessons.

climax.text: Pets.com went from IPO to shutdown in 268 days. The sock puppet outlived the company.

punchline.text: IPO to dead in 268 days. The puppet was worth more than the business.

quiz.question: How much did Pets.com spend for every $1 earned?
